questions.question: The average of 11 numbers is 32. If the average of the first six numbers is 26 and the average of the last six numbers is 36 then what is the value of the sixth number
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of 11 numbers is 32.

The average of the first six numbers is 26.

The average of the last six numbers is 36.

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of observations/Number of observations

**Calculation:**

The sum of all eleven numbers = 32 × 11

⇒ 352 ----(i)

And the sum of first six numbers = 26 × 6

⇒ 156 ----(ii)

And the sum of last six numbers = 36 × 6

⇒ 216 ----(iii)

On adding (ii) and (iii), we get

Sum of all eleven numbers + sixth numbers = 156 + 216

⇒ 372

352 + sixth number = 372

Sixth number = 372 - 352

**∴ Sixth number is 20.**

questions.question: Set A contains seven numbers and the average of these numbers is 41. Set B contains five numbers and the average of these numbers is 44. Find the overall average of both the sets.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Set A contains seven numbers and the average of these numbers is 41

Set B contains five numbers and the average of these numbers is 44

**Solution: **

Sum of all seven numbers of set A = 41 × 7 = 287

Sum of all five numbers of set B = 44 × 5 = 220

⇒ The average of all the numbers of set A and set B is = (287 + 220)/12

∴ Required average is 42.25

questions.question: A fraction is such that the numerator is five less than the denominator. Also four times the numerator is one more than the denominator. Find the Fraction.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numerator is five less than the denominator

Also four times the numerator is one more than the denomination

**Solution: **

Let the denominator of fraction be x

⇒ The numerator of fraction = (x - 5)

And also, according to question

4 × (x - 5) = x + 1

⇒ 4x - 20 = x + 1

⇒ 3x = 21

⇒ x = 7

So, the fraction is (7 - 5)/7

∴ 2/7

questions.question: If in a triangle, angles are in the ratio 1 : 1 : 2 and the length of its longest side is 6√2cm, then find the area (in cm²) of the triangle?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Angles of triangle are in the ratio 1 : 1 : 2

The length of its longest side is 6√2 cm

**Solution: **

Let the ratio be x

So, angles are x, x and 2x

Since, sum of angles of triangle = 180°

⇒ x + x + 2x = 180°

⇒ 4x = 180°

⇒ x = 45°

The angles of triangle are 45°, 45° and 90°

The triangle is an isosceles triangle

If we take the equal side of isosceles triangle ‘a’

Then its longest side will be √2a

So, √2a = 6√2 cm

⇒ a = 6

The equal sides are of 6 cm

Area of triangle = ½ × 6 × 6

**∴ The area of the triangle is 18 cm²**

questions.question: Amar, Bhavan, Chetan and Dinesh have a total of Rs. 150 with them. Amar has one-fourth of the total amount with the others. Find the amount with Amar (in Rs).
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Amar, Bhavan, Chetan and Dinesh have a total of Rs. 150 with them

Amar has one-fourth of the total amount with the others

**Solution: **

Let the Amar has Rs. x out of Rs. 150

So, the amount with others = (150 - x)

According to question,

x = 1 /4 × (150 - x)

⇒ 4x = (150 - x)

⇒ 5x = 150

⇒ x = 30

∴ Amar has Rs. 30

questions.question: If the speed of steam is 20% of the speed of boat in still water and it covers 120 km upstream in 150 minutes, then what is the downstream speed of the boat?
questions.solution:
The speed of steam is 20% of the speed of boat in still water

It covers 120 km upstream in 150 minutes

**Solution: **

Let the speed of boat in still water be x km/hour

⇒ The speed of stream is 20% of x = x/5

⇒ The speed of boat in upstream = x - x/5 = 4x/5

And the speed of boat in downstream = x + x/5 = 6x/5

Now, according to question

120 = (4x/5) × 150/60

⇒ 120 = 2x

⇒ x = 60

So, the downstream speed of boat = 6 × 60/5

∴ The downstream speed of the boat is 72 km/hour

questions.question: A room is in the shape of cube and the length of the longest rod placed in it is 21√3 cm. Find the area of the floor.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A room is in the shape of a cube and the length of the longest rod placed in it is 21√3 cm

**Solution: **

Since the longest rod that can be placed inside a room is along the diagonal of the room

The length of the diagonal of the cubical room = length of the room

⇒ √3a = 21√3, where a is the length of the side of the room

⇒ a = 21

Since, the area of floor = a²

⇒ The area of floor = (21)²

**∴ The area of the floor is 441 cm².**

questions.question: If 40% of x equal 50% of y, then find the value of y : x.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

40% of x equal 50% of y

**Solution: **

40% of x equal 50% of y

⇒ 40/100 × x = 50/100 × y

⇒ 4x = 5y

∴ y : x = 4 : 5

questions.question: If the height of a circular cone is decreased by 10% and its radius is increased by 10% then what will be the change in its volume?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The height of a circular cone is decreased by 10%

And its radius is increased by 10%

**Solution: **

Let the height and radius of the cone are h and r respectively

Original volume = π r² h/3 = V (let)

According to the question,

New height = 90% of h = 9h/10

New radius = 110% of r = 11r/10

New volume = π (11r/10)² × 9h/10 × 1/3

⇒ π r² h × 1089/1000 × 1/3

⇒ 1089V/1000

Percentage increment 

⇒ (1089V/1000 - V)/V × 100

⇒ (89V/1000V) × 100

⇒ 8.9%

**∴ The required answer is 8.9%**

questions.question: A contractor takes a contract to complete a road in 60 days and employed 70 labours. After 25 days, he found that one fourth of the total work is complete. How many more labours he requires to complete the remaining work in time?
questions.solution:

A contractor takes a contract to complete a road in 60 days and employed 70 labours

After 25 days, he found that one fourth of the total work is complete

**Solution: **

Since, in 25 days ¼ part of the work is completed by 70 labours

⇒ In 1 day ¼ part of the work is completed by (70 × 25) labours

⇒ In 35 days ¼ part of the work is completed by (70 × 25)/35 labours

⇒ In 35 days ¾ part of the work is completed by (70 × 25)/35 × 3 labours

⇒ 150 labours

⇒ The number of extra labours required = 150 - 70

∴ Extra 80 labours requires to complete the remaining work in time.

questions.question: A sum doubles in seven years at simple interest. In how many years will the sum become five times the original sum?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A sum doubles in seven years at simple interest

**Solution: **

Let the principal be P, rate be R%, time be T and amount be A

According to question,

2P = P + (P × R × 7)/100

⇒ R = 100/7

Now,

5P = P + P × (100/7) × T/100

⇒ 4P = P × T/7

⇒ T = 28

∴ Required time is 28 years.

questions.question: If 20% of the goods are sold at 50% profit, 40% of the goods at 20% loss, 20% of the goods at 5% loss and the remaining at no loss or no profit, find then the overall profit percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

20% of the goods are sold at 50% profit

40% of the goods at 20% loss

20% of the goods at 5% loss

And the remaining at no loss or no profit

**Solution: **

Let the cost price of goods be Rs. 100

Since, cost price of 20% goods is Rs. 20

⇒ Selling price of 20% goods is Rs. 20 × 150% = Rs. 30

Since, cost price of 40% goods is Rs. 40

⇒ Selling price of 40% goods is Rs. 40 × 80% = 32

Since, cost price of 20% goods is Rs. 20

⇒ The selling price of 20% goods is Rs. 20 × 95% = 19

Since, the remaining amount of goods is 20%

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 20

⇒ The total selling price = 30 + 32 + 19 + 20 = Rs. 101

⇒ The overall profit percentage = (101 - 100)/100 × 100

∴ The overall profit percentage is 1%

Factor of 12 = 2² × 3

So, the L.C.M of 12 and 144 = 2⁴ × 3² 

∴ The value of (72 × 84) @ 144 is 144.

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold an article for Rs. 180 by making a profit of 20%. The shopkeeper offered a discount of Rs. 30 on the market price. How much percent above the cost price the article is marked?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Shopkeeper sold an article for Rs. 180 by making a profit of 20%

The shopkeeper offered a discount of Rs. 30 on the market price

**Solution: **

Let the cost price of the article be Rs. x

According to question,

x × 120% = 180

⇒ x × 6/5 =180

⇒ x = 150

And marked price = 180 + 30 = Rs. 210

So, percent = (210 - 150)/150 × 100

∴ Required percent is 40%

questions.question: Working together, A and B can complete a work in 12 days. They work together for 9 days after which B leaves. If A finishes the remaining work in 5 days, then the number of days that B alone would take to complete the work is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete a work in 12 days

They work together for 9 days after which B leaves. If A finishes the remaining work in 5 days

**Solution:**

Since, work done by (A + B) in 12 days = 1

⇒ The work done by (A + B) in 1 day = 1/12

⇒ The work done by (A + B) in 9 days = 9/12 = 3/4 work

⇒ The remaining work = 1/4

According to question,

1/4 work is done by A in 5 days

⇒ Total work done by A alone in 20 days

⇒ The work done by B in one day = 1/12 - 1/20 = 1/30

**∴ B can alone finish the work in 30 days **
